answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The vault is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble.
